title: One more allocated cell
statement: Let $ho$ be either the rightward or leftward direction, let $\\gamma$ be a guide tape, and let $j$ be a natural number. Updating the $j$-cell filled tape at coordinate $j$ in the rightward direction or $-j$ in the leftward direction with the guide mark for that coordinate yields the $(j+1)$-cell filled tape.
hypotheses_covered: The direction is Boolean, selecting rightward or leftward
The guide tape is a function from integer coordinates to optional symbols
replaced:
Updating the $j$-cell filled version of a guide tape at cell $j$ (rightward)
respectively $-j$ (leftward) with the corresponding guide mark yields the $(j+1)$-cell
filled version.
